title: Signed vertex insertion boundary for contravariant profinite functors
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a preadditive category [def-weil-preadditive-category], and let $H:\mathrm{Profinite}^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal C$ be any functor in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For a profinite space $Z$, use the powers $Z^r$ of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Let $d_i:Z^{n+2}\to Z^{n+1}$ delete coordinate $i$ and put $D_{Z,n}=\sum_{i=0}^{n+1}(-1)^i H(d_i)$. For continuous $a,b:X\to Y$, let $a_r:X^{r+1}\to Y^{r+1}$ apply $a$ coordinatewise, and let $h_{n,i}:X^{n+1}\to Y^{n+2}$ be $(x_0,\ldots,x_n)\mapsto(a x_0,\ldots,a x_i,b x_i,\ldots,b x_n)$. Put $P_{a,b,n}=\sum_{i=0}^n(-1)^iH(h_{n,i})$. Then for every $n\geq0$, as morphisms from $H(Y^{n+2})$ to $H(X^{n+2})$, one has $D_{X,n}\circ P_{a,b,n}+P_{a,b,n+1}\circ D_{Y,n+1}=H(b_{n+1})-H(a_{n+1})$. The definitions require neither internal modules nor an evaluation datum and allow empty profinite spaces.

proof.text: Expand the two composites as finite double sums, using bilinearity and functoriality of H. In the second double sum index the insertion by i and the deletion by j.

proof.text: For j<i the parameter maps satisfy d_j h_i = h_(i-1) d_j. For j>i+1 they satisfy d_j h_i = h_i d_(j-1). The inverse pairing of a term (k,r) in the first sum is (r+1,k) if k≤r and (r,k+1) if k>r. The corresponding signs differ by one power of -1, so all these terms cancel.

source.place: Tag 019S, equation-homotopy-to-homotopy and the cancellation preceding lemma-homotopy-s-N; contravariant profinite-tuple adaptation.

proof.text: For j=i and j=i+1 the surviving parameter maps are t_i and t_(i+1), where t_i applies a in positions strictly before i and b in the remaining positions. Their signs are +1 and -1. The sum telescopes to the all-b map minus the all-a map. These are equalities of continuous maps checked coordinatewise, so no point or nonemptiness hypothesis is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem prism_boundary (H : Profinite.{u}ᵒᵖ ⥤ C) {X Y : Profinite.{u}}
    (a b : C(X, Y)) (n : ℕ) :
    prism H a b n ≫ differential H X n +
      differential H Y (n + 1) ≫ prism H a b (n + 1) =
      H.map (coordinate b (n + 1)).op - H.map (coordinate a (n + 1)).op
